To install the starter app example, enter the following command:  ibmcloud fn sdk install iOS  This command downloads a compressed file that contains the starter app. The project directory contains a Podfile. Mobile SDK   IBM Cloud® Functions provides a mobile SDK for iOS and watchOS devices that enables mobile apps to fire remote triggers and invoke remote actions. You can build the mobile SDK by using Xcode 9.  The mobile SDK is not supported for IAM-based namespaces. Use a Cloud Foundry-based namespace instead.     Add the SDK to your app   You can install the mobile SDK by using CocoaPods, Carthage, or from the source directory.     Install mobile SDK with CocoaPods   The IBM Cloud® Functions SDK for mobile is available for public distribution through CocoaPods.
